responsibility: This generator translates machine-description pipeline automaton constructs—such as DEFINE_CPU_UNIT, DEFINE_RESERVATION, DEFINE_INSN_RESERVATION, bypasses, exclusion/presence/absence sets, and automata options—into the finite-state automata tables and helper functions used by GCC’s DFA-based scheduler and hazard recognizer. It parses the target pipeline description, checks and expands the internal NDFA/DFA model, optionally determinizes and minimizes automata, and emits the generated transition, latency, reservation-printing, cpu-unit query, cache, initialization, and statistics code that implements runtime scheduling-state queries.
